title: A Mac artifact write whose artifact id is not recognised is treated as a waiting-page write.
ruling: Coordinator choice, 04:54 CST Nov 10, reported in the body of PR 2549: owner item 440 gave the Mac tool input shapes but not the field that names the artifact. Until that field is known, a Mac db_* call with no recognised id gets the full waiting-page item checks. This fails safe; the cost is a possibly misleading denial on a write to another artifact, cleared by an override. The open question is debt mac-artifact-id-key-unknown, closed by reading one redacted db_write input on the owner's Mac.
quote: Coordinator choice (04:54 CST Nov 10): a Mac db_* call with no recognised id counts as a waiting-page write and gets the full item checks. It fails safe.
